notes.title: SLEEP AWAKE will be launching in 2026!
notes.content: [h1]SLEEP AWAKE will be launching in 2026![/h1][p][/p][p]Just announced in the Future Games Show, SLEEP AWAKE will be launching next year. But if you join the [url="https://discord.gg/blumhouse"]Blumhouse Games Discord[/url], you'll find out when you can play it sooner.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="XLWuPUJfE2I;full"][/previewyoutube]
